prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original desktop wallpaper. Title for concept only: Afterglow. Create an exquisite abstract digital-blur artwork: a broad, soft, vermilion-red light ribbon refracting through smoked glass, a pale rose afterimage and faint deep slate shadows. Long luminous streaks gently bend diagonally across the lower right and dissolve into a very spacious dark upper left. Artistic intentional defocus with velvety diffusion, delicate analog film grain, barely visible chromatic smearing, atmospheric and tactile, like an experimental long-exposure gallery photograph. Several scales of blur and subtle tonal layers; no crisp objects, no generic glowing ball, no synthetic UI gradient mesh. Meditative late-night mood, sophisticated editorial art direction, beautiful at full-screen scale. Palette: predominantly ink charcoal #080809, graphite #14161c and smoky slate, with deep crimson #b91f2e and restrained vermilion-pink #ff5261 light; subtle warm ivory highlights are allowed. It must harmonize with a dark charcoal and crimson desktop UI. Rich tonal detail, not crushed blacks. Full-bleed widescreen wallpaper, 16:9 landscape composition, ideally 2560x1440 or larger. No text, letters, logos, border, frames, UI, watermarks or contact sheet. Create ONE finished image.
